# LiveChat - The Best AI Live Chat Software for Business | LiveChat.com

> LiveChat® is the best AI live chat software for business, perfect for ecommerce and B2B. It powers real-time website support, boosting sales and customer satisfaction. Quick to set up, easy for your team to use and a go-to choice for your customers.

Benefits of LiveChat® for Your Business:
- Faster response times – Live chat conversations let you assist customers immediately and reduce wait times.
- AI Agents – Intelligent virtual agents can handle common queries, provide instant answers, and assist human agents, further improving response times and efficiency.
- Increased customer satisfaction – Real-time communication ensures customers feel heard and supported, improving their experience.
- Boosted sales and conversions – Addressing customer concerns instantly reduces purchase barriers and encourages faster decisions.
- Improved efficiency – Agents can handle multiple chats at once, making live chat support a cost-effective solution.
- 24/7 availability – Automated chatbots allow businesses to offer round-the-clock support.
- Proactive engagement – Businesses can initiate conversations to assist visitors, boosting customer engagement and trust.
- Valuable customer insights – Analytics tools provide data on customer behavior and preferences to improve strategies.
- Reduced operational costs – Fewer phone support needs save businesses money while maintaining high-quality service.
